record.model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-IQ1_M, both shards (native, not the requant)
record.prefill_chunking: --max-num-batched-tokens 32 (one PA block) --max-prefill-chunk-tokens 512: the recurrent prefix checkpoint is only captured when a prompt *step* ends on a 32-token block boundary, so a one-shot prompt never gets one. A 32-token step makes every boundary restorable and costs no measurable prefill throughput (11-13 tok/s either way). Measured: 1.9k-token chat turn prompt_ms 141,871 -> 5,557; 641-token turn 56,471 -> 2,242.
